operations.title: Benincasa closes exceptional Kummer physical activation under frozen sources
operations.body: Entry 1123 completes the bounded provenance audit. arXiv:2408.16386 defines the loop integral and invokes i-epsilon; arXiv:2402.06558 defines E -> E-i epsilon_E for each energy plus the Cayley-Menger fiber contour/measure. Neither gives a graph-level relation among epsilon_E or a map confining the exceptional slope to one regulator chamber; no such supplementary/worksheet datum is frozen in the repository. Therefore this center closes source-relatively: carrier/Cousin and Kummer coefficient established, physical activation undefined, new carrier unsupported. We should redirect to a generic marked-relative comparison with a pre-existing physical chain map.
